summary: DestProfileHistory is a user control (ASP.NET Web UserControl) designed to display and manage the history of a Destination Profile. It interacts with user session data, agency context, and provides a grid-based UI for presenting profile history.
purpose: To show the historical information and changes related to a Destination Profile for a specified agency and session context.

fields.description: User interface button, purpose not described in retrieved content.

fields.description: UI label for display, specific usage not described.

fields.name: gridData
fields.description: Displays destination profile history in a tabular format.

fields.name: dsDestProfileHistory
fields.description: Provides data to the grid, feeds profile history information.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: Session object storing user and agency context.

fields.name: DestID
fields.description: Identifier for the Destination Profile being viewed.

workflows.name: Display Destination Profile History
steps: User navigates to the profile history control.
System cancels data retrieval if UserSession is null.
System sets input parameters for data source: DestinationCodeID (DestID), SessionAgencyID (from UserSession), sess (UserSession object).
System retrieves and displays profile history data in gridData.

business_rules: Profile history can only be viewed if a valid UserSession exists.
Data retrieval requires valid DestinationCodeID and SessionAgencyID.
validations: UserSession must not be null; otherwise, data retrieval is canceled.
conditions: If UserSession is null, ObjectDataSourceSelecting event is canceled.
system_behavior: Cancels selection and data retrieval if user session is missing.
Provides agency-contextual historical data based on session and destination ID.
exceptions: No data is retrieved if UserSession is null.
